tools.name: list_chart_types
tools.description: List all amCharts 5 chart types with their categories and reference file names

tools.name: get_chart_reference
tools.description: Get the reference documentation for a specific amCharts 5 chart type. A reference longer than 12,000 characters comes as an overview: its first parts in full and a list of the others, each of which get_section returns. With `full: true` it is the whole file. The chart type keywords are listed by list_chart_types.

full.description: true: the whole reference, however long. false (default): an overview when it is long.

tools.name: get_core_reference
tools.description: Get the core amCharts 5 reference (SKILL.md) — covers setup, colors, themes, legends, tooltips, events, data, adapters, disposal, and common pitfalls. It is the base for every chart type; the chart-specific references build on it. It comes as an overview: its first sections, up to 12,000 characters, and a list of the others, each of which get_section("SKILL", heading) returns. With `full: true` it is the whole file.

full.description: true: the whole SKILL.md (about 105,000 characters). false (default): the overview.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the curated amCharts 5 skill docs (SKILL.md + chart references) for a keyword or topic, returning matching sections ranked by relevance. By default it searches only the skill layer. With scope 'all' it also searches the extended docs, the per-class API reference and the code examples. Per-setting defaults (e.g. tooltip background cornerRadius, axis tick `visible` default, cursor line strokeDasharray) are in the extended docs and the API reference, which search_all, get_api_reference and get_doc also return.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'legend', 'axis label rotation', 'tooltip format', 'data processor'

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)

scope.description: 'skill' (default) searches only the curated skill docs; 'all' also searches the extended docs / per-class API reference where settings and defaults live, and the code examples.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get the full text of one section of a doc by heading, for example a section that a search_docs or search_all result shows truncated. `file` accepts the source label exactly as search results print it ('skill/SKILL.md', 'skill/xy', 'extended/charts/xy-chart/cursor', 'reference/xycursor') as well as a bare skill file name ('SKILL', 'xy', 'map').

file.description: Doc identifier: a skill file ('SKILL', 'xy', 'pie', 'map') or a source label from search results ('skill/SKILL.md', 'extended/concepts/events', 'reference/xycursor'). '.md' and 'skill/' / 'extended/' prefixes are optional.

heading.description: Section heading to retrieve (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'Core setup pattern', 'Axis types', 'Common pitfalls', 'Recent API changes'. A ### subsection heading returns just that subsection.

tools.name: get_quick_start
tools.description: Get a quick-start template for a specific chart type — a minimal working example ready to customize.

format.description: Output format: 'html' for a full HTML page with CDN scripts, 'esm' for ES module imports

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Search across all amCharts 5 content: skill references, full documentation, and code examples. For broad searches across everything.

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'react integration', 'date axis formatting', 'stacked bar example'. An amcharts.com link (a demo or a docs page) is answered with the call that returns it.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get a full documentation page — an extended doc by path, or a skill file by 'skill/<name>'. Paths are the source labels that search_docs and search_all print.

path.description: Doc path, e.g. 'charts/xy-chart/cursor', 'concepts/events', 'getting-started/integrations/react', 'reference/xycursor' (per-class API), or a skill file such as 'skill/SKILL.md' / 'skill/xy'. A docs address works too ('https://docs.amcharts.com/v5/concepts/events/', its '.md', or the older www.amcharts.com/docs/v5/ form); a demo address returns that demo's example. A class's full settings and defaults are in its API reference (get_api_reference).

tools.name: get_api_reference
tools.description: Get the per-class API reference for an amCharts 5 class: the class page plus its settings table (with defaults) and, optionally, its private/read-only settings. It is generated from the library's typings, so it has the exact setting names and default values (e.g. tooltip background cornerRadius, axis tick `visible` default). Takes a class name in any casing, e.g. 'XYCursor', 'Tooltip', 'PieSeries', 'AxisRendererX'.

className.description: amCharts 5 class name, e.g. 'XYCursor', 'Tooltip', 'PieSeries', 'ColumnSeries', 'AxisRendererX'. Casing/punctuation are ignored. Its reference address works too: 'https://docs.amcharts.com/v5/reference/xycursor/'.

includePrivate.description: Also include the private (read-only / internal) settings table. Default false.

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: List all available amCharts 5 code examples, optionally filtered by category.

category.description: Filter by category, e.g. 'column-bar', 'line-area', 'pie-donut', 'maps', 'flow', 'hierarchy', 'stock', 'gantt', 'gauges', 'radar-polar', 'timeline', 'funnel-pyramid', or 'json-configs' (complete JSON configs from the amCharts npm package). Without it, all categories are listed.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Get the full code for a specific amCharts 5 example/demo, by its path or its amcharts.com demo address. Paths are listed by list_examples and printed in search results.

path.description: Example path, e.g. 'examples/flow/sankey-diagram', 'examples/pie-donut/donut-chart', 'examples/maps/drill-down-map', or a demo address such as 'https://www.amcharts.com/demos/sankey-diagram/'

tools.name: list_geodata
tools.description: List amCharts 5 geodata (map) files with each one's CDN path, script global name and ES module import: world maps, continents, every country map, regional packs (US states and counties, Canada, Mexico) and the US congressional-district packs, which are versioned per Congress (congressional120 = 120th Congress is the newest). Also the data/countries2 and lang/* helper files. It gives the exact file path and global name that map code needs.

filter.description: Words that must all match (case-insensitive) a map's path, label, group, ISO code or pack, e.g. 'germany', 'FR', 'region/canada', 'usa counties', 'congressional120', 'congressional whole country', 'continents', 'countries2'. A file or global name ('usaCongressionalLow', 'am5geodata_worldLow') works too. Without it, the result is an overview.
